# TeleCrypt.io Storage SDK

Library-only end-to-end encrypted file storage and sharing on Matrix. The canonical installation,
API, encryption, sharing, Recovery Key, and development guidance is in [README.md](./README.md);
the guarded exact-tag publication procedure is in [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md).

Current package: `@telecrypt-io/storage@0.5.0`. Consumers must pin an exact version. The package
exports the `TeleCryptIOStorage` library and the browser-safe `@telecrypt-io/storage/core` API; it
does not provide a command-line executable. The CLI and static web application are separate
repositories and release artifacts.
